about: Limits Signalpost checks before anything is scheduled. They come from each network's help pages and Upload-Post's API docs, checked November 2026. Networks change their rules: edit this file when they do. 'block' stops a post from being scheduled. 'warn' lets it through but tells you in the pull request.

formats.reel: One vertical video (Instagram Reel, TikTok video, YouTube Short, Facebook Reel)
formats.video: One video of any shape (a YouTube video, a LinkedIn or X video)
formats.carousel: Two or more photos posted together
formats.story: One photo or video that disappears after 24 hours

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.tips: Hook in the first line, because only about 125 characters show before 'more'. Up to 5 hashtags. Links aren't clickable in captions.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.tips: Short and spoken. Say what happens in the video, a question or a hook, then 3 to 5 hashtags. Photo posts need a title of 90 characters or fewer.

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.tips: A clear, searchable title of 100 characters or fewer (60 shows best). The description says what the video covers, with links. Shorts are vertical and 3 minutes or shorter. No < or > anywhere.

facebook.name: Facebook
facebook.tips: Conversational, a few lines. Links work. Hashtags matter little; use one or two at most.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.tips: Professional and specific: the people, the work, the lesson. First two lines carry the post (about 210 characters show before 'see more'). Up to 3 hashtags at the end.

x.name: X
x.tips: 280 characters. Upload-Post removes links from X posts, so don't put any in. One or two hashtags at most.

threads.name: Threads

hashtags.why: Threads uses one topic tag instead of hashtags.

threads.tips: Conversational, 500 characters. No hashtags: set one topic tag instead. Links work.

pinterest.name: Pinterest
pinterest.tips: Pinterest is a search engine: a title with the words people search for (100 characters or fewer), a useful description (500 or fewer) and a destination link.
